"""Appended to the frozen diagnostic adapter in the selected runtime only.

No import invokes native tools. Root supplies one fresh selection before dispatch.
"""
import importer
import reference_contract
import auxiliary_inventory
_ROOT = None
_OFFICIAL = None
_ORIGINAL_SELECT = select_command
_ORIGINAL_RUN_OBSERVED = run_observed


def configure_root(selection):
    global _ROOT
    require(_ROOT is None, 'Root selection already configured')
    _ROOT = importer.validate_root(selection)


def select_command(h, argv, session):
    require(_ROOT is not None and list(map(str,argv)) == importer.command_argv(_ROOT,session), 'Command must come from root-selected context')
    require(session.resolve() == session and session.is_dir() and not session.is_symlink() and session.name == 'session' and session.parent.name == 'runtime' and session.parent.parent.name == 'native-run-v4-'+_ROOT['runID'], 'Root-selected fresh result workspace required')
    require(not (session/'session.xcresult').exists() and not (session/'session.xcresult').is_symlink(), 'Result bundle exists before dispatch; replay refused')
    _ORIGINAL_SELECT(h,argv,session)
    _selected['sessionIdentity'] = path_identity(session,0o700)
    _selected['rootSHA256'] = sha(importer.stable(_ROOT))



def path_identity(path, mode=None):
    require(path.resolve() == path and path.is_dir() and not path.is_symlink(), 'Canonical owned directory required')
    info = path.lstat()
    require(mode is None or stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == mode, 'Owned directory mode changed')
    return (info.st_dev,info.st_ino,info.st_uid)


def run_observed(commands, argv, timeout, check, retained_stdout_filter):
    result = _ORIGINAL_RUN_OBSERVED(commands,argv,timeout,check,retained_stdout_filter)
    require(path_identity(_selected['session'],0o700) == _selected['sessionIdentity'], 'Selected session identity changed during command')
    _selected['resultIdentity'] = path_identity(_selected['session']/'session.xcresult')
    return result


def observer_terminal(summary, code, argv=None):
    # The observer's own full stream binding is checked again at final import.
    cleanup = summary.get('cleanup',{})
    return (summary.get('schema') == 'mixer.apple-command-finalization-observer.2'
        and type(code) is int and summary.get('exitCode') == code
        and (argv is None or summary.get('argv') == argv)
        and summary.get('startNewSession') is True
        and summary.get('ownedProcessGroup',{}).get('state') == 'absent'
        and ((cleanup.get('attempted') is True and cleanup.get('complete') is True)
             or (cleanup.get('attempted') is False and cleanup.get('complete') is None and cleanup.get('signals') == []))
        and set(summary.get('streams',{})) == {'stdout','stderr'}
        and all(row.get('eof') is True and row.get('readerFailed') is False and row.get('readerErrors') == [] for row in summary['streams'].values())
        and summary.get('successInferredFromConsoleOrMarkers') is False)



def application_captures(output):
    captures, auxiliary = auxiliary_inventory.validate(output/'runtime/captures',_ROOT['ownedSimulatorIdentity'])
    return captures


def capture_official(commands, base_run, h, output):
    """Called by the selected command wrapper; bytes originate in actual tool returns.

    Matching IDs in stored evidence cannot call this path or replace its outputs.
    """
    global _OFFICIAL
    require(_selected is not None and _selected['called'] and _OFFICIAL is None, 'Exactly one actual selected command capture required')
    session = _selected['session']
    require(_selected['rootSHA256'] == sha(importer.stable(_ROOT)) and session == output/'runtime/session' and h.RUN_DIR == output/'runtime', 'Official capture differs from root-selected run/path')
    require(path_identity(session,0o700) == _selected['sessionIdentity'] and path_identity(session/'session.xcresult') == _selected['resultIdentity'], 'Official result/session path identity substituted')

        code, stdout, stderr = base_run(commands,argv,check=False)
        require(type(code) is int and code == 0, 'Official result traversal command failed')

    require(retained.get('ownedResultPath') == str(session/'session.xcresult') and retained.get('exitCode') == 0 and retained.get('passed') is True, 'Selected official attachment export failed')
    folder = output/'runtime/attachments'
    manifest = folder/'manifest.json'
    require(manifest.is_file() and not manifest.is_symlink(), 'Selected official manifest absent')
    official['manifest'] = manifest.read_bytes()
    # Traverse actual official execution identities before attachment bytes are joined.
    observer = importer.read(session/'command-observer/observer.json')
    importer.official_methods(importer.parse(official['summary']),importer.parse(official['tests']),_ROOT,observer['exitCode'],importer.decimal_document(official['summary']))
    payloads = {}
    for name, row in retained['files'].items():
        require(Path(name).name == name, 'Nested attachment refused')
        path = folder/name
        require(path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink() and path.resolve() == path, 'Attachment export entry redirected')
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        require(len(raw) == row['bytes'] and sha(raw) == row['sha256'], 'Attachment bytes changed before capture')
        if name != 'manifest.json': payloads[name] = raw
    require({path.name for path in folder.iterdir()} == set(retained['files']), 'Attachment export inventory changed')
    require(path_identity(session,0o700) == _selected['sessionIdentity'] and path_identity(session/'session.xcresult') == _selected['resultIdentity'], 'Official result/session substituted during traversal')
    captures = application_captures(output)
    captured = {'official':importer.CapturedOfficial(importer._CAPTURE_TOKEN,_ROOT,session,observer['exitCode'],official,payloads,captures),'payloads':payloads,'captures':captures,'runID':_ROOT['runID'],'argv':list(_selected['argv'])}
    receipt = {'schema':'mixer.apple-focus-reference-official-capture.1','runID':_ROOT['runID'],'rootSelectionSHA256':sha(importer.stable(_ROOT)), 'argv':_selected['argv'],'officialSHA256':{k:sha(v) for k,v in official.items()},'payloadSHA256':{k:sha(v) for k,v in payloads.items()},'applicationCaptureSHA256':{k:sha(v) for k,v in captures.items()},'officialToolInvocations':invocations,'sessionIdentity':list(_selected['sessionIdentity']),'resultIdentity':list(_selected['resultIdentity']),'nativeQualification':False}
    with (output/'runtime/official-capture.json').open('xb') as stream:
        stream.write(importer.stable(receipt));stream.flush();os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    _OFFICIAL = captured


def runtime_summary(base, h, oracle, setup_ready, scope, bridge, xctest_exit, failure, cleanup_results):
    report = {'schema':'mixer.apple-focus-reference-runtime.3','diagnosticOnly':True,'diagnosticOutcome':'unknown','runPassed':False,'strictNativeVerdictsPassed':False,'completeCaseSet':False,'cursorCompletionCredit':False,'fullSixCaseQualification':False,'nativeKeyboardQualification':False,'carrierAccepted':False,'gaAccepted':False,'physicalPhones':'disconnected-deferred','cleanupResults':cleanup_results,'sessionFailure':failure,'xcodebuildExitCode':xctest_exit,'selectedMethods':list(importer.METHODS),'selectedApplicationCases':[importer.CASE],'actualNativeInputActions':None}
    if cleanup_results is None or _OFFICIAL is None: return report
    try:
        require(_OFFICIAL['runID'] == _ROOT['runID'] and _OFFICIAL['argv'] == _selected['argv'], 'Official capture belongs to another dispatch')
        require(failure is None and getattr(h,'reporting_state',{}).get('firstFailure') is None, 'Runtime command/reporting failure prevents diagnostic import')
        require(bridge is not None and list(bridge.failures) == [] and setup_ready(bridge.settings), 'Durable Settings completion required')
        session = _selected['session']; observer_dir = session/'command-observer'
        captures = application_captures(base)
        require(captures == _OFFICIAL['captures'], 'Application observations changed after selected official capture')
        imported = importer.import_selected(_ROOT,session,importer.read(observer_dir/'observer.json'),{name:(observer_dir/(name+'.log')).read_bytes() for name in ['stdout','stderr']},_OFFICIAL['official'],_OFFICIAL['payloads'],captures,cleanup_results,oracle,reference_contract)
        report.update(imported,actualNativeInputActions=imported['keyInjectionCount'],settingsDiagnostic=bridge.settings.summary(),bridgeFailures=list(bridge.failures))
    except (KeyError,ValueError,TypeError,OSError,OverflowError,RecursionError) as error:
        report.update(diagnosticOutcome='invalid-or-incomplete-evidence',failure=type(error).__name__+': '+str(error))
    return report

"""Closed validation of actual bridge/Settings outputs; auxiliary bytes grant no app authority.

The unchanged Session validates and reconstructs each journal-linked publication
in memory. The unchanged TransactionStore's successful hard-link publication and
retirement receipts must account for every retained attempt and payload.
"""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import uuid
import importer as i
import reference_contract as contract
import settings_telemetry as telemetry

APP_FILES = {'0001-begin.json','0001-ready.json','0001-command-1.json','0001-command-2.json','0001-before-1.json','0001-after-1.json','0001-keyboard-witness-1.json','0001-focus-diagnostic-1.json'}
ROLES = {'begin':'0001-begin.json','before':'0001-before-1.json','after':'0001-after-1.json','witness':'0001-keyboard-witness-1.json'}


def regular(path, limit=2_000_000, links=None):
    info=path.lstat()
    i.require(path.resolve()==path and stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and 0<info.st_size<=limit and (links is None or info.st_nlink==links),'Auxiliary path/type/size/link count changed: '+path.name)
    return path.read_bytes()


def directory(path):
    info=path.lstat()
    i.require(path.resolve()==path and stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink(),'Auxiliary directory redirected: '+path.name)


def bridge_summary(folder, app):
    value=i.parse(regular(folder/'bridge-summary.json',links=1))
    i.require(type(value) is dict and set(value)=={'generation','currentCase','allowedCases','verdicts','failures','lastValidObservationAvailable','capabilityRetained'},'Closed bridge summary required')
    i.require(type(value['generation']) is int and value['generation'] in (0,1) and value['currentCase']==(None if value['generation']==0 else i.CASE),'Bridge summary generation/case differs')
    i.require(value['allowedCases']==[i.CASE] and value['failures']==[] and value['capabilityRetained'] is False and type(value['lastValidObservationAvailable']) is bool,'Bridge summary failure/uncertainty/scope rejected')
    i.require(type(value['verdicts']) is list and len(value['verdicts'])<=1,'Bridge summary duplicate verdict rejected')
    if value['generation']==0:
        i.require(not app and value['verdicts']==[] and value['lastValidObservationAvailable'] is False,'Bridge summary conceals application generation')
    else:
        i.require('0001-begin.json' in app,'Bridge summary generation lacks application begin')
        if '0001-after-1.json' in app:
            after=i.parse(app['0001-after-1.json'])
            i.require(contract.strict_json_equal(value['verdicts'],[after.get('verdict')]),'Auxiliary summary differs from retained app verdict')
        else:i.require(value['verdicts']==[],'Auxiliary verdict lacks authoritative application after sample')
    return value


def validate(folder, identity):
    directory(folder)
    entries={path.name:path for path in folder.iterdir()}
    i.require(len(entries)<=6000 and 'bridge-summary.json' in entries,'Bounded actual bridge summary inventory required')
    i.require('.settings-transaction-guard.json' not in entries,'Unresolved Settings transaction guard rejects capture')
    app={name:regular(path,limit=16_000_000,links=1) for name,path in entries.items() if name in APP_FILES}
    summary=bridge_summary(folder,app)
    journal_names=sorted(name for name in entries if name.startswith('0000-settings-'))
    i.require(len(journal_names)<=telemetry.MAX_REQUESTS,'Settings journal count exceeds unchanged request cap')
    i.require(journal_names==[f'0000-settings-{n:04d}.json' for n in range(len(journal_names))],'Settings journal sequence/name differs')
    expected_payloads={};per_journal={};journals={}
    if journal_names:
        first=i.parse(regular(folder/journal_names[0],links=2))
        i.require(type(first) is dict and set(first)=={'receivedUptime','generation','sessionDeadlineUptime','diagnosticDeadlineUptime','record','ownedSimulatorIdentity'},'Closed first Settings journal required')
        i.require(type(first['generation']) is str and str(uuid.UUID(first['generation']))==first['generation'],'Canonical Settings session generation required')
        i.require(contract.strict_json_equal(first['ownedSimulatorIdentity'],identity),'Settings journal belongs to another owned device')
        clock=[first['receivedUptime']];generated=[];active=[None]
        def persist(suffix,value):
            i.require('0000-'+suffix+'.json'==active[0],'Settings replay suffix differs')
            generated.append({**value,'ownedSimulatorIdentity':identity})
        def publish(slot,form,payload):
            name=slot+('.png' if form=='png' else '.txt')
            i.require(name not in expected_payloads and Path(name).name==name,'Duplicate/redirected journal-linked Settings payload')
            expected_payloads[name]=payload;per_journal[active[0]].append(name)
            i.require(regular(folder/name,limit=2_000_000,links=2)==payload,'Settings payload differs from Session-reconstructed bytes')
        session=telemetry.Session(persist,publish,first['sessionDeadlineUptime'],now=lambda:clock[0],token=first['generation'])
        for index,name in enumerate(journal_names):
            saved=i.parse(regular(folder/name,links=2));journals[name]=saved;active[0]=name;per_journal[name]=[]
            expected={'receivedUptime','record','ownedSimulatorIdentity'} | ({'generation','sessionDeadlineUptime','diagnosticDeadlineUptime'} if index==0 else set())
            i.require(type(saved) is dict and set(saved)==expected and type(saved['record']) is dict and contract.strict_json_equal(saved['ownedSimulatorIdentity'],identity),'Closed Session journal/identity required')
            i.require(i.number(saved['receivedUptime']),'Settings receipt time malformed')
            clock[0]=saved['receivedUptime'];session.request(saved['record'])
            i.require(len(generated)==index+1 and contract.strict_json_equal(generated[-1],saved),'Settings journal differs from complete unchanged Session replay')
        replay=session.summary()
    else:
        replay=None
    attempts=folder/'.settings-attempts'
    if journal_names:
        i.require(attempts.name in entries,'Settings journal lacks retained transaction attempts')
        directory(attempts);children=list(attempts.iterdir())
        i.require(len(children)==len(journal_names),'Settings attempts/journals are not one-to-one')
        accounted=set()
        for attempt in children:
            directory(attempt)
            i.require(str(uuid.UUID(attempt.name))==attempt.name,'Noncanonical Settings attempt identity')
            outcome=i.parse(regular(attempt/'outcome.json',links=1))
            i.require(type(outcome) is dict and set(outcome)=={'ancillary','commitPoint','journal','outcome','retirement'} and outcome['ancillary']==[] and outcome['outcome']=='committed' and outcome['commitPoint']=='successful-evidence-exact-publication-and-publication-directory-fsync','Settings failed/ancillary/unresolved attempt rejected')
            i.require(contract.strict_json_equal(outcome['retirement'],{'state':'resolved','guardAbsenceEstablished':True,'directoryFsyncSucceeded':True,'committedRequestUnchanged':True}),'Settings guard retirement unobserved/uncertain')
            journal=outcome['journal']
            i.require(type(journal) is str and journal in journals and journal not in accounted,'Foreign/duplicate Settings attempt journal')
            accounted.add(journal)
            expected={journal,*per_journal[journal]}
            i.require({p.name for p in attempt.iterdir()}==expected|{'outcome.json'},'Unexpected/unreferenced staged Settings publication')
            for name in expected:
                staged,final=attempt/name,folder/name
                raw=regular(staged,limit=2_000_000,links=2)
                i.require(raw==regular(final,limit=2_000_000,links=2) and os.path.samefile(staged,final),'Staged Settings publication identity/bytes differ')
        i.require(accounted==set(journal_names),'Missing Settings transaction outcome')
    else:
        i.require(attempts.name not in entries,'Settings attempts without valid Session journals rejected')
    allowed=APP_FILES|{'bridge-summary.json'}|set(journal_names)|set(expected_payloads)|({'.settings-attempts'} if journal_names else set())
    i.require(set(entries)<=allowed,'Unrecognized/failure/foreign generation/action Settings or app artifact')
    # Auxiliary data cannot supply any of these roles. Return only the four fixed
    # application files; native import still needs selected official attachments.
    return {role:app[name] for role,name in ROLES.items() if name in app}, {'schema':'mixer.apple-focus-reference-auxiliary-inventory.3','bridgeSummaryGeneration':summary['generation'],'settingsJournalCount':len(journal_names),'settingsPayloadCount':len(expected_payloads),'settingsAttemptCount':len(journal_names),'settingsReplay':replay,'authoritativeApplicationEvidenceCreated':False}

"""Strict selected-execution import. Inputs are captured by the root-owned runtime adapter.

This module never invokes a tool. Host fixtures can exercise consistency only;
native provenance starts in adapter.capture_official(), not in evidence fields.
"""
import copy
import datetime
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import uuid

METHODS = ('test000PublicSettingsFullKeyboardAccess', 'test010ReferenceFirstTab')
CASE = 'keyboard-enabled-off'
SOURCE = '696bfdd8a31be7b4d9ba49f57783625c7edbb75c126bb4696e31acc5aa0f238a'
PRODUCT = '0941185e39cc0171b0bf5d2aeb72738588e88b9c7b3d676f893b70c3bf644fa8'
PREFIX = 'test://com.apple.xcode/MixerToggleUITests/MixerToggleUITests/ToggleUITests/'


def require(value, message):
    if not value: raise ValueError(message)


def digest(data): return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def stable(value): return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()


def parse(raw):
    require(type(raw) is bytes and len(raw) <= 2_000_000, 'Bounded raw JSON bytes required')
    def pairs(items):
        value = {}
        for key, item in items:
            require(key not in value, 'Duplicate JSON object member')
            value[key] = item
        return value
    def constant(value): raise ValueError('Non-finite JSON constant: ' + value)
    value = json.loads(raw.decode('utf-8'), object_pairs_hook=pairs, parse_constant=constant)
    def finite(item, depth=0):
        require(depth <= 100, 'JSON nesting exceeds importer bound')
        if type(item) is float: require(math.isfinite(item), 'Overflowed JSON number')
        elif type(item) is dict:
            for nested in item.values(): finite(nested, depth + 1)
        elif type(item) is list:
            for nested in item: finite(nested, depth + 1)
    finite(value)
    return value


def read(path):
    require(path.resolve() == path and path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink(), 'Canonical regular evidence required')
    return parse(path.read_bytes())


def number(value): return type(value) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(value) and value >= 0



def datetime_ns(value):
    stamp=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(value)
    require(stamp.tzinfo is not None,'Timezone-aware root wall time required')
    delta=stamp.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc)-datetime.datetime(1970,1,1,tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    return ((delta.days*86400+delta.seconds)*1_000_000_000+delta.microseconds*1000)


MAX_TIMESTAMP_TOKEN_BYTES = 1024
# The ordinary JSON pass already rejects numbers outside finite binary64 range.
# Its largest accepted second value has at most 309 integer digits, hence at
# most 318 nanosecond digits. Check before any power or integer construction.
MAX_TIMESTAMP_NS_DIGITS = 318


def decimal_timestamp_ns(value):
    """Exact tuple conversion; no Decimal arithmetic or ambient context reads.

    A genuine sub-nanosecond endpoint remains incomplete evidence. Trailing
    decimal zeroes and exponent notation are accepted when exactly integral.
    Work is bounded by the token/coefficient and result lengths, never by an
    attacker-controlled exponent. Even extreme zero exponents need no power.
    """
    require(type(value) is Decimal and value.is_finite(),'Original finite decimal wall-time token required')
    sign,digits,exponent=value.as_tuple()
    require(len(digits)<=MAX_TIMESTAMP_TOKEN_BYTES,'Timestamp coefficient exceeds importer bound')
    nonzero=any(digits)
    require(not sign or not nonzero,'Original nonnegative decimal wall-time token required')
    if not nonzero:return 0
    power=exponent+9
    if power<0:
        cut=-power
        require(cut<len(digits) and not any(digits[-cut:]),'Official timestamp exceeds nanosecond representation; ordering is incomplete')
        digits=digits[:-cut]
        power=0
    require(len(digits)+power<=MAX_TIMESTAMP_NS_DIGITS,'Timestamp nanosecond range exceeds importer bound')
    coefficient=0
    for digit in digits:coefficient=coefficient*10+digit
    return coefficient*10**power


def decimal_document(raw):
    # parse() first validates duplicates, raw syntax, depth and finiteness. The
    # second pass retains original decimal lexemes exclusively for wall ordering.
    parse(raw)
    def exact_number(token):
        require(len(token)<=MAX_TIMESTAMP_TOKEN_BYTES,'Timestamp decimal token exceeds importer bound')
        try:return Decimal(token)
        except InvalidOperation as error:raise ValueError('Unrepresentable exact decimal token') from error
    return json.loads(raw.decode('utf-8'),parse_float=exact_number,parse_int=exact_number)


def signature(value):
    require(type(value) is list and len(value)==4,'Closed native file signature required')
    inode,mtime,size,digest_value=value
    require(type(inode) is int and inode>0 and type(mtime) is int and mtime>=0 and type(size) is int and 0<size<=16_000_000,'Exact native inode/nanosecond mtime/byte length required')
    require(type(digest_value) is str and len(digest_value)==64 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in digest_value),'Original native file SHA256 shape required')
    return value


def validate_root(value, packet_sha=None, fresh=False):
    require(type(value) is dict and set(value) == {'schema','runID','packetSHA256','selectedAtUTC','ownedSimulatorIdentity','sourceTreeSHA256','productArchiveSHA256','developerDirectory','baselineDevices','baselineFrontends'}, 'Closed root selection required')
    require(value['schema'] == 'mixer.apple-focus-reference-root-selection.5', 'Root selection schema differs')
    require(str(uuid.UUID(value['runID'])) == value['runID'], 'Canonical fresh run UUID required')
    require(type(value['packetSHA256']) is str and len(value['packetSHA256']) == 64 and (packet_sha is None or value['packetSHA256'] == packet_sha), 'Root selected packet differs')
    require(value['sourceTreeSHA256'] == SOURCE and value['productArchiveSHA256'] == PRODUCT, 'Root source/product identity differs')
    identity = value['ownedSimulatorIdentity']
    require(type(identity) is dict and set(identity) == {'udid','name','runtime','build'}, 'Closed owned simulator identity required')
    require(str(uuid.UUID(identity['udid'])).upper() == identity['udid'] and type(identity['name']) is str and identity['name'].startswith('MixerFocusReferenceV5-'), 'Root-owned canonical simulator identity required')
    require(identity['runtime'] == 'com.apple.CoreSimulator.SimRuntime.iOS-26-5' and identity['build'] == '23F77', 'Pinned runtime/build required')
    require(value['developerDirectory'] == '/Applications/Xcode_26.6.app/Contents/Developer', 'Pinned compiler tools directory required')
    require(type(value['baselineDevices']) is dict and type(value['baselineDevices'].get('devices')) is dict and type(value['baselineFrontends']) is list, 'Root pre-creation baseline required')
    require(all(type(rows) is list and all(type(item) is dict and item.get('udid') != identity['udid'] for item in rows) for rows in value['baselineDevices']['devices'].values()), 'Owned simulator already in root pre-creation baseline')
    selected = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(value['selectedAtUTC'])
    require(selected.tzinfo is not None, 'Timezone-aware root selection required')
    if fresh:
        age = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc) - selected
        require(datetime.timedelta(0) <= age <= datetime.timedelta(seconds=300), 'Root selection is stale or future-dated')
    return copy.deepcopy(value)


def command_argv(root, session):
    return [root['developerDirectory'] + '/usr/bin/xcodebuild','test-without-building','-xctestrun',str(session / 'session.xctestrun'),'-destination','platform=iOS Simulator,id=' + root['ownedSimulatorIdentity']['udid'],'-parallel-testing-enabled','NO','-maximum-concurrent-test-simulator-destinations','1','-resultBundlePath',str(session / 'session.xcresult')] + ['-only-testing:MixerToggleUITests/ToggleUITests/' + method for method in METHODS]


def observer_terminal(observer, root, session, streams):
    expected = command_argv(root, session)
    require(observer.get('schema') == 'mixer.apple-command-finalization-observer.2' and observer.get('argv') == expected and observer.get('resultBundle') == str(session / 'session.xcresult'), 'Observer selected command/result differs')
    require(type(observer.get('exitCode')) is int and observer['exitCode'] in (0,65), 'Terminal selected XCTest outcome required')
    require(observer.get('startNewSession') is True and observer.get('successInferredFromConsoleOrMarkers') is False, 'Owned observed command required')
    pid, group = observer.get('PID'), observer.get('processGroup')
    require(type(group) is int and group > 0 and type(pid) is int and pid == group, 'Owned process group identity required')
    owned = observer.get('ownedProcessGroup', {})
    require(owned.get('state') == 'absent' and type(owned.get('targetProcessGroup')) is int and owned.get('targetProcessGroup') == group, 'Owned group absence not observed')
    cleanup = observer.get('cleanup', {})
    require((cleanup.get('attempted') is True and cleanup.get('complete') is True) or (cleanup.get('attempted') is False and cleanup.get('complete') is None and cleanup.get('signals') == []), 'Observer cleanup incomplete/unobserved')
    require(set(observer.get('streams', {})) == {'stdout','stderr'} and set(streams) == {'stdout','stderr'}, 'Two observed streams required')
    for name, stream in observer['streams'].items():
